title: AI Act regulatory framework
date_evidence: European Commission AI Act reference page; the operative date for Danish law firms is the 2 August 2026 full-application date for high-risk AI systems including legal-services and judicial-decision tools.
key_claim: EU AI Act fully applicable from 2 August 2026 with high-risk classification covering AI in legal proceedings and judicial decisions; conformity assessments, technical documentation and CE marking required by that date; non-compliance penalties up to 35 million euros or 7 percent of global turnover for prohibited practices, 15 million euros or 3 percent for other violations.

title: Advokatsamfundet structural review committee and bylaw changes
date_evidence: Advokatsamfundet governance page covering Advokatraadet's 2026 work programme including structural review, decorum, geographic representation and diversity recommendations; bylaw changes to be voted at the general lawyer meeting later in 2026.
key_claim: Advokatraadet (the Bar Council) is running a structural review on how to secure future supply of volunteers for court, council and committees; recommendations expected to lead to bylaw changes voted at the 2026 general lawyer meeting; Martin Lavesen replaced Peter Fogh as chairman of Advokatraadet, marking the first leadership change in six years.

title: IBA kommer til Koebenhavn i 2026: nu er datoerne paa plads
date_evidence: Danske Advokater news article confirming IBA Annual Conference Copenhagen 2026 dates of 4 to 9 October 2026 at Bella Center; published January 2026 alongside the IBA Copenhagen site inspection.
key_claim: IBA Annual Conference Copenhagen 2026 confirmed for 4 to 9 October 2026 at Bella Center; Danske Advokater hosting the world's largest legal congress, projected to bring 5,000-plus attendees from 2,700-plus law firms across 130-plus jurisdictions; Copenhagen visibility moment for Danish legal services market.

title: IBA Annual Conference Copenhagen 2026 official conference page
date_evidence: IBA official conference reference page for Copenhagen 2026 (4-9 October 2026 at Bella Center); early-bird registration deadline 10 July 2026.
key_claim: IBA Copenhagen 2026 official conference page confirms 4-9 October 2026 dates, 5,000-plus attendees, 2,700-plus law firms from 130-plus jurisdictions; early-bird deadline 10 July 2026.

title: Advokaten 1 2026: young-lawyer priorities survey
date_evidence: Advokaten magazine 1/2026 issue published February 2026; carries Advokatraadet survey on young lawyers' priorities (family and leisure time ranked above compensation).
key_claim: Advokatraadet 2026 survey finds family and leisure time with friends ranked most important in young lawyers' lives, with compensation a secondary driver; signals a generational shift in the talent supply story that Danish firms have built junior-recruitment models around.

title: Kromann Reumert, Europe 2026 profile
date_evidence: Chambers Europe 2026 published March 2026; Kromann Reumert profile confirms top-tier rankings across Corporate/M&A, Tax, IP, Competition/European Law and International & Cross-Border Capabilities.
key_claim: Chambers Europe 2026 rankings published March 2026 confirm Kromann Reumert at top tier (Band 1) across the headline Danish practice areas (Corporate/M&A, Tax, IP, Competition/European Law); the firm reports nearly 550 professionals including 400 lawyers across all major practice areas.

title: Information Technology, Denmark, Europe 2026 rankings
date_evidence: Chambers Europe 2026 Information Technology Denmark rankings published March 2026; Bird & Bird ranked Band 1 with stellar IT practice serving domestic and international clients.
key_claim: Chambers Europe 2026 IT Denmark rankings (March 2026) place Bird & Bird at Band 1 covering full spectrum of IT outsourcing, procurement, data protection and telecommunications mandates; reinforces that international-affiliated Danish offices have captured the legal-tech and AI-regulation practice corner.

title: Artificial Intelligence 2026: Denmark trends and developments
date_evidence: Chambers Practice Guides 'Artificial Intelligence 2026: Denmark' published April 2026; covers Denmark-specific AI Act preparation, the role of Danish firms in advising on high-risk AI, and the August 2 2026 deadline.
key_claim: Chambers Practice Guides 2026 Denmark AI chapter documents the practical rollout of EU AI Act compliance work at Danish firms ahead of the 2 August 2026 deadline, with Danish firms advising clients on high-risk classification, conformity assessments and provider-vs-deployer obligations.

title: A Lawyer's Guide to the EU AI Act
date_evidence: Bloomberg Law Pro Insights guide published February 2026 on EU AI Act compliance for legal practice; informs how firms across the EU and the Nordics are preparing for August 2026.
key_claim: Bloomberg Law's February 2026 lawyer's guide to the EU AI Act lays out the binding obligations: 2 August 2026 conformity-assessment cutoff for high-risk AI, technical documentation, CE marking and EU database registration, with classification turning on whether the firm acts as end-user, deployer or provider.

title: Nordics regional integration page
date_evidence: Bird & Bird Nordic regional reference page describing the firm's integrated Nordic operations across Denmark, Finland and Sweden.
key_claim: Bird & Bird describes itself as the first fully integrated international law firm with presence across the key Nordic jurisdictions (Denmark, Finland, Sweden); 120-plus lawyers across the three offices; pan-Nordic integration is the binding model competing with the Danish independents.

title: Harvey Wins Firm-Wide Deployment at Kromann Reumert
date_evidence: TipRanks news article published February 2026 on Kromann Reumert's firm-wide Harvey AI deployment; the deal was announced in February 2026.
key_claim: Kromann Reumert deployed Harvey AI platform firm-wide in February 2026 after a security- and compliance-focused evaluation prioritising Microsoft-native integration; the CIO stated the firm is 'now live with Harvey across the firm, no longer testing but using the platform actively in our daily work'.
verbatim_quote: now live with Harvey across the firm, no longer testing but using the platform actively in our daily work

title: Legal AI startup Harvey valued at $11 billion in funding round
date_evidence: CNBC article dated 25 March 2026 (URL contains 2026/03/25); Harvey legal-AI startup raised USD 200m at USD 11bn valuation, signalling the global capital reweighting toward legal-AI as a category.
key_claim: Harvey raised USD 200m at a USD 11bn valuation in March 2026, with venture capital spreading bets beyond pure model companies into legal-vertical-AI; deal coincided with the Kromann Reumert firm-wide deployment, reinforcing the European-BigLaw adoption thesis.

title: Legal Tech 2026 Guide for Danish Law Firms
date_evidence: ClearContract published guide on Danish-law-firm legal-tech, dated 22 January 2026 per WebSearch snippet header; URL contains the year and the platform tags the guide as the 2026 edition.
key_claim: Vendor-side analysis: by 2026, legal technology shifts from experimental adjunct to integral part of Danish law-firm operations, with contract automation, redlining and reporting moving from pilot to production; growing Danish-language tooling reduces the long-standing English-language vendor gap.

title: Heldagskonference: Fremtidens Advokatvirksomhed
date_evidence: Danske Advokater conference page for 'Fremtidens Advokatvirksomhed' (The Future of Law Firms) covering competencies, profitability and strategic strength for Danish firms in 2026-2030.
key_claim: Danske Advokater's flagship conference for 2026 frames three drivers of the next-three-year Danish legal-services market: human competencies that survive AI commoditisation, profitability under fee-pressure, and strategic positioning against international and pan-Nordic competitors.

title: Sports Law 2026 Denmark: Trends and Developments
date_evidence: Chambers Practice Guides Sports Law 2026 Denmark chapter published April 2026; documents the Wasserman acquisition of Danish agency People in Sport (January 2026) as a marker of international consolidation pressure on Danish boutiques.
key_claim: International agency Wasserman acquired the football division of Danish boutique People in Sport in January 2026, illustrating the pattern of international consolidation reaching Danish specialty practices; sports law adjacent but a directional indicator for legal-services consolidation.

title: Kromann Reumert Selects Harvey
date_evidence: Harvey vendor blog announcement of Kromann Reumert firm-wide deployment; published February 2026 alongside the firm's go-live; treat directionally because Harvey is the vendor.
key_claim: Harvey vendor blog confirms Kromann Reumert as the first Nordic firm-wide Harvey deployment; includes statement from the managing partner that Harvey supports lawyers in delivering smarter, faster and more precise advice; vendor framing.
